query:
SELECT
                COALESCE(SUM(
                    (blob->'data'->>'available')::bigint - (blob->'data'->>'fees')::bigint
                ), 0)::bigint AS "pending!",
                COALESCE(bool_or(input_ys && $2), false) AS "locked!"
            FROM treasury_onchain_melt_ops
            WHERE status = $1
